scope: PMO surface and structured-state boundary, Reviewer lens contract, root/starter parity, and compact human review surface. No authentication, authorization, session, secret storage, external service, dependency, CI/CD, deployment, release, publish, package metadata, or starter-promotion action changed.

adversarial_security_review.secret_session_token_exposure: pass; source-intake and high-volume PMO state are no longer required human Markdown folders and no raw evidence examples were added
adversarial_security_review.injection_path_traversal_untrusted_input: pass; path validation uses fixed contract folders and no user-supplied path execution was added
adversarial_security_review.fail_closed_behavior: pass; forbidden legacy/generated/structured PMO folders produce diagnostics instead of being silently accepted

deferred_risks.rationale: PKT-04A only reclassifies PMO surfaces and Reviewer lenses; PKT-05 owns query-ready long-memory and question-answering indexes.
Local CSO-style evidence is packet-scoped and does not replace formal organization-specific security signoff.
